create_function_registry: create a function registry to map string names to callable backend functions
build_registry_context: build a context manager that temporarily replaces the function registry for local modifications
test_copy_registry: test copying the function registry and config registry into a serializable tuple
refactor_with_current_registry: refactor an executable to attach the current function registry so it runs with correct context
summarize_registry_reference: summarize the RegistryReference class used to mark entries that should be shallow-copied during registry duplication
